rationale: fastdiff_flow_pixel_unconstrained-claude-agentic: image_size=512, pixel_spacing=0.3516, n_angles=128, n_det=1024, det_spacing=0.35754, sod=500.0, sdd=1000.0, display_min=0.0, display_max=0.5, train_n=400, val_n=200, noise_i0=100000.0, noise_sigma_e=10.0, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_pixel_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.4, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=0, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.5, rationale=iter-2: DC-off breast-prior. ONE KNOB init_t 0.7->0.4. PRIOR iter-1: hr=0, PSNR 19.0 vs sparse-FBP baseline PSNR 36.3 (RMSE 3.8e-2 vs 5.2e-3) - the DC-free sampler drifted far from measurement. FAILURE MODE: init_t=0.7 injects 70% noise into the FBP embedding; with NO hard DC anchor and only soft DPS guidance the generative prior hallucinates plausible breast texture and loses fidelity. HYPOTHESIS: lowering init_t to 0.4 injects less noise so the DC-free sampler stays anchored near the measured FBP -> PSNR/RMSE improve toward baseline. init_t is the dominant fidelity lever when DC is off.
